suggestion.topic: Python GIL Explained: Why Multi-Threading Fails You
suggestion.rationale: Developers constantly hit performance bottlenecks in Python multithreading and wonder why CPU utilization stays at 100% on a single core. This demystifies the CPython Global Interpreter Lock with high watch-time retention.
suggestion.hook_angle: Your Python multi-threading code is secretly running on a single core, and here is the exact reason why.
